title: Open-Meteo Geocoding API — Pietermaritzburg and Durban
claims: The Open-Meteo geocoding result for Pietermaritzburg, South Africa, gives latitude -29.61679, longitude 30.39278 and elevation 636 m.
The Open-Meteo geocoding result for Durban, South Africa, gives latitude -29.8579, longitude 31.0292 and elevation 21 m.
The geocoding service states that its data comes from GeoNames.

verification.note: 2026-11-08 查询 Open-Meteo geocoding API；Pietermaritzburg 与 Durban 均返回 country_code ZA、经纬度与 elevation。仅用于 mapAnchor 与天气查询坐标，不用于赛道几何。

claimVerification.note: API 响应本身未在结果字段内重复许可声明；Open-Meteo 文档将 geocoding 数据归于 GeoNames。本条按文档写，未把 API 返回当作许可文本。
